entries.text: You see the water guard.
entries.source_text: You see the water guard.

entries.text: Hello,
entries.source_text: Hello,

entries.text: Hello. How are you doing?
entries.source_text: Hello. How are you doing?

entries.text: Gahh!
entries.source_text: Gahh!

entries.text: Well Gahh! back to you . . . I'm sorry that you never learned to speak. We might have been good friends.
entries.source_text:
Well Gahh! back to you . . . I'm sorry that you never learned

entries.text: Ouph.
entries.source_text: Ouph.

entries.text: I'm not feeling very well. Someone cracked my head with a big pipe. I went to the medic but my head still hurts. Sure hope someone catches the jerk that hit me.
entries.source_text:
I'm not feeling very well. Someone cracked my head
 with a big pipe. I went to the medic but my head still
 hurts. Sure hope someone catches the jerk that hit me.

entries.text: Why did they do that?
entries.source_text: Why did they do that?

entries.text: Guck.
entries.source_text: Guck.

entries.text: Well, they attacked me while I was here pretty late one night. Usually I go home by eight or so, but I was staying late since someone had some water stolen and I was checking our supplies. Next thing I know, I wake up in the med-lab with a big bump on my head. Things are getting crazy around here. Someone is going to get killed for water soon and I don't know what we can do about it.

entries.text: Sorry. I hope you feel better soon.

entries.text: Here's your water.

entries.text: Here's your ration for today.

entries.text: Hey! What do you think you're doing?!?
entries.source_text: Hey! What do you think you're doing?!?

entries.text: Please don't take so many supplies. We need those.

entries.text: You log your reports in the library computer system. You should return to the overseer to finalize your progress.

entries.text: Good day,
entries.source_text: Good day,

entries.text: Hi. How have things been lately?
entries.source_text: Hi. How have things been lately?

entries.text: Say, what are you doing here?
entries.source_text: Say, what are you doing here?

entries.text: Well, everyone's pretty nervous, of course, but we haven't had too much trouble. I hope you find a new chip soon.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: I hand out the water rations, of course. And I make sure that nobody tries to take more water than their share, though I don't think we'll have any trouble.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: Hmm. Well, keep up the good work.

entries.text: You too. I hope you find that chip soon so we can all go back to a normal life.

entries.text: You're welcome to take supplies if you need them, since your job is so important, but please don't take too much. We don't have much left.
